abstract: Monitors hull pressure integrity, environmental control seals, and emergency abort corridors
system_message:
You are the Safety and Environmental Assurance Officer (SAO), responsible for monitoring hull pressure integrity, environmental control seals, and emergency abort corridors, as well as tracking micro-meteoroid shield integrity across orbital cargo ferry flight profiles.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Micro-meteoroid shield integrity（LEAK）
information_points.content:
SAO-LEAK-FQF：For the Phased Co-Elliptic Rendezvous Profile, the Whipple bumper thickness on the forward pressure vessel outer micrometeoroid fairing is 16 mm according to ultrasonic scan measurements.
SAO-LEAK-301：Ultrasonic scans of the forward pressure vessel outer micrometeoroid fairing for the Direct Hohmann Fast-Track Profile demonstrate a Whipple bumper thickness of 20 mm.
SAO-LEAK-LRT：For the Multi-Loop Resonant Elevation Profile, the sacrificial Whipple bumper thickness on the forward pressure vessel outer micrometeoroid fairing measures 12 mm.

information_points.title: Monitors hull pressure integrity, environmental control seals, and emergency abort corridors（HULL）
information_points.content:
SAO-HULL-KER：For the Direct Hohmann Fast-Track Profile, chamber leak-decay verification confirms that the structural pressurization seal is validated for the main hatchway and docking ring elastomer seal, keeping dry air leakage within station ingress tolerance.
SAO-HULL-RZX：For the Phased Co-Elliptic Rendezvous Profile, the structural pressurization seal is validated across the main hatchway and docking ring elastomer seal based on chamber leak-decay verification.
SAO-HULL-HDZ：For the Multi-Loop Resonant Elevation Profile, chamber leak-decay testing indicates that the structural pressurization seal is not validated, as dry air leakage across the main hatchway and docking ring elastomer seal does not meet station ingress limits.
